title: Nakedness
summary: NAKEDNESS, noun 1. Want of covering or clothing; nudity; bareness. 2. Want of means of defense. Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land are ye come. Genesis 42:9. 3. Plainness; openness to view

inlines.v: NAKEDNESS, noun 1. Want of covering or clothing; nudity; bareness. 2. Want of means of defense. Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land are ye come. Genesis 42:9. 3. Plainness; openness to view. To uncover nakedness in Scripture, is to have incestuous or unlawful commerce with a female.
